landing.faq1Q: How is this different from Google Translate with voiceover?
landing.faq1A: We clone the original actor's voice and preserve their emotional delivery. It's voice transformation, not translation + TTS. Your actors speak perfect English while sounding like themselves.
landing.faq2Q: Can you really dub martial arts films?
landing.faq2A: Yes. Martial arts films are the hardest dubbing challenge (fast action, intense emotion, fight sounds). We've proven it works with Ip Man. If it works there, it works anywhere.
landing.faq3A: We use SyncNet, the industry-standard tool for measuring lip-sync accuracy (LSE-D metric). Every segment is scored for frame-accurate sync.
landing.faq4A: 24-48 hours for feature-length films. Short content (under 10 min) processes in real-time.
landing.faq5A: Professional tier includes a full timeline editor for manual refinement, voice adjustment, and perfect control.
landing.faq6A: 50+ languages, optimized for Asian cinema (Cantonese, Mandarin, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Korean, Japanese).
landing.testimonial: DubMaster is the first AI platform to successfully dub high-action martial arts scenes while preserving actors' voices and emotional intensity. If you can dub Ip Man, you can dub anything.
